l.x: West of the compound the cactus creatures fill the valley; only the Dew Collectors carry a dew gland. Most mobs in Tanaris can drop OOX-17/TN's distress beacon, rarely: keep it if you see one. Careful: The other thistleshrub mobs in the area are level 49-50 and wander a lot, so you can easily pull extra mobs.

Tooga attend dans la vallée. Accompagnez-le jusqu'à sa femme Torta à Steamwheedle Port, au nord-est à travers le désert : restez près de lui, ralentissez pour lui et repoussez ce qui l'attaque. Ne montez pas en selle et n'utilisez pas votre pierre de foyer hors de sa portée. Yeh'kinya se tient aussi dans le port.
Acceptez « La quête de Tooga » (Tooga)
Terminez « La quête de Tooga »

h: Gorge des Vents brûlants: kill these as you meet them

l.x: Heavy War Golems patrol the Cauldron below Kalaran and drop the oil; the Magma and Blazing Elementals drifting among them drop the hearts. The Dark Iron Taskmasters and Slavers drive the slaves on the paths; a Slaver may drop the Clé des toilettes de Crasseboue: keep it. The Greater Lava Spiders roam the plateaus and lava pools in the south-west of the gorge. The Slag Pit opens in the north of the Cauldron. Incendosaurs swim in its lava pools: pull them to the edge. The secret plans lie on the pit's upper ledge. Careful: Dark Iron Slavers (level 45-46) call for help from allies within 15 yd when pulled, cast Net from up to 15 yd, and use Rend in melee.
